limits: No real Material supervisor/CLI hookup in this layer; loader is a separate reviewed successor.
Complete payload over 16 KiB is rejected, never paged/truncated. This layer does not establish that every real source fits.
Observer/issuer/lease checks are bounded before/after observations, not a new atomic lease across unrelated owners.
Cancellation or process death is not proved by this offline review; no task completion or cold process recovery is claimed.
Same signed Material context authenticates binding; original E/D path still checks actual ledger/freeze evidence before issuing receipts.
scope: One non-Clone Material host exported once from the same original task; private Arcs retain existing owners, not the runtime or daemon Config.
Registration binds a separate Material process and exact E/D actors; real f42 peer/pidfd/SO_PEERCRED checker remains unchanged and same UID/PID rejection is retained.
Requests carry only fixed complete context, nonce and monotonic request ID. No wire run/path/action/actor dispatch.
Root original Source encoding follows same Task/Cell/Source current readback and original Dataset Source predicate; it never encodes a caller receipt.
Private client decode is reachable only after a successful bound Root channel exchange; actual pair consumption is the sole constructor caller.
All client clones share one slot/counter/end. Failure after taking a slot does not restore it; no queue/reconnect/retry.
Root full context/current/deadline is checked after response as well. A late server failure does not retract an already sent response or assert NotApplied.
Original Material LedgerWriter, full freeze verification, signers, admission bits and four original command permits are not changed.
